quotations.old_english: Æ´nig man ciricþén ne útige búton biscopes geþehte
quotations.english: let no man turn out a church-minister without the bishop's counsel

source_text: ciric-þén, es; m. [þén a servant, minister] A church-minister, clergyman; ecclesiæ minister, clericus :-- Æ-acute;nig man ciricþén ne útige búton biscopes geþehte let no man turn out a church-minister without the bishop's counsel, L. Eth. v. 10; Th. i. 306, 29: vi. 15 ; Th. i. 318, 27.
